claims.text: Startups.com.br reported 340 startups and innovative companies in the 2025 delegation: 256 selected by ApexBrasil and Sebrae, 84 by partners including Softex, Anprotec and Serpro.
claims.quote: Das 340 startups e empresas inovadoras participantes, 256 foram selecionadas pela ApexBrasil e o Sebrae. Outras 84 foram escolhidas por instituições parceiras, como Softex, Anprotec e Serpro.

claims.text: The year before (2024), ApexBrasil and Sebrae selected 226 startups, as Startups.com.br reported.
claims.quote: No ano passado, ApexBrasil e Sebrae selecionaram 226 startups.

claims.text: Startups.com.br reported that 123 of the 340 would be at the summit for the first time.
claims.quote: A maior parte das participantes deste ano (123) estará no evento pela primeira vez

claims.text: DN Brasil reported more than 370 startups based in Brazil at Web Summit 2025.
claims.quote: mais de 370 startups sediadas no Brasil

claims.text: DN Brasil reported 151 participants selected by ApexBrasil, 80 of them from the Southeast (the percentages printed beside the counts do not add up and are not recorded).
In November 2023 ApexBrasil said it would take 85 startups and 100 companies to Web Summit Lisboa, a record delegation.
claims.quote: vai levar 85 startups e 100 empresas à Web Summit Lisboa, uma delegação recorde

claims.text: The 2023 delegation more than doubled the 80 companies of 2022, the year of the first Brazil Pavilion.
claims.quote: mais do que duplica em relação a 2022, quando participaram 80 empresas, no ano de estreia do Pavilhão Brasil

claims.text: ApexBrasil's rules for innovation hubs state that Germany and Brazil had the two largest delegations at Web Summit 2025.
claims.quote: Alemanha e Brasil tiveram as duas maiores delegações.

claims.text: The innovation-hubs rules give the 2025 Brazilian delegation as almost 380 companies, 247 of them supported by ApexBrasil, Sebrae Nacional and Serpro.
claims.quote: A delegação brasileira contou com quase 380 empresas, sendo 247 startups e empresas inovadoras apoiadas pela parceria ApexBrasil, Sebrae Nacional e Serpro

claims.text: The mission rules give the same 2025 delegation as 380 companies (the hubs rules say almost 380), 247 of them supported by ApexBrasil, Sebrae Startups and Serpro.
claims.quote: A delegação brasileira contou com 380 empresas, sendo 247 startups e empresas inovadoras apoiadas pela parceria ApexBrasil, Sebrae Startups e Serpro
